paraphrase: Moheyan's replies: all beings are bound by deluded discriminating thought; when thoughts arise one does not follow them, 'not thinking, not examining', and the originally pure mind appears; the six perfections are included in this non-examining.
speaker: Moheyan
notes: From memory; no local text. The Indian/Tibetan side (Kamalaśīla's Bhāvanākrama) is recorded by other units.
